description:
Wristband-linked wallet: top-up, spend at points of sale, balance refund after the event. A cash path — full NF525 journal treatment.

**Conditions of Success:**
- Top-up/spend/refund are journal entries; wallet balance is a projection that always reconciles
- Spend works at simulated POS latency, offline-tolerant with reconciliation
- Post-event balance refund flow completes to the original payment method (fake PSP)

Lineage: docs/product/brief.md · docs/product/prd-v1.md (capability map).
